title: Isolate security scanners in a Docker image and keep CI as an evidence consumer
acceptance_criteria: The scanner image contains the scan entrypoint and its required scripts.
CI Security invokes one scanner runner in the pinned image and uploads only its declared non-sensitive evidence output, while remaining compatible with the currently pinned tools-only digest.
The scanner-image workflow rebuilds when the packaged scanner scripts change.
Harness and applicable shell checks pass.

external_authorization.authorized_action: Commit and push this task to GitHub; the existing Scanner Image Release workflow may publish the scanner image to GHCR.
